strategy.summary: CART-12 prices the cart at checkout via cartTotal(items, { coupon }) in src/cart.js: a 10% bulk discount at 10+ total items, the SAVE5 coupon after the bulk discount (goods floored at $0) with other codes refused, and $4.99 shipping unless the discounted goods reach $50, with an empty cart costing nothing. Unit tests in Vitest prove each rule at its boundaries through the public cartTotal function, using the exported constants where possible. Reading the code shows the bulk check uses `> BULK_THRESHOLD` (so exactly 10 items get no discount) and the coupon lookup uses `in`, which accepts inherited keys like "toString".
inScope: cartTotal pricing: bulk discount, SAVE5 coupon, unknown coupon refusal, shipping threshold, empty cart
Boundaries: 9/10 items, $50 goods after discounts, goods floored at $0
outOfScope: Checkout UI or API (none exists in this repo)
Currency rounding beyond what the cases' amounts exercise
assumptions: cartTotal(items, { coupon }) is the checkout pricing entry point; it returns the amount the customer pays (goods after discounts plus shipping), rounded to cents.
'Refused with an error' means cartTotal throws; the test checks the thrown message contains the submitted code (the part the test controls).
Coupon codes are case-sensitive (only exactly 'SAVE5' is valid), as the code implements; the ticket names the code exactly.
An 'empty cart' is an items array with no lines.
openQuestions: Should a cart whose lines all have quantity 0 count as empty (no shipping)? The code charges $4.99 for it; not tested.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cart with 10 or more items in total (sum of line quantities) gets 10% off its subtotal; fewer than 10 gets no bulk discount.
Coupon SAVE5 takes $5 off after the bulk discount, the goods never go below $0, and any other coupon code is refused with an error.
Shipping is free when goods after discounts are $50 or more, otherwise $4.99; an empty cart costs $0.

defects.title: Bulk discount not applied to a cart of exactly 10 items
defects.description: AC1: a cart with 10 or more items gets 10% off. bulkDiscount (src/cart.js:22) uses `itemCount(items) > BULK_THRESHOLD`, so exactly 10 items get no discount. Expected total 63 for [{10×4},{5×6}], actual 70.
defects.evidence: AssertionError: expected 70 to be 63 // Object.is equality

defects.title: Coupon codes matching Object.prototype keys (e.g. 'toString') are accepted
defects.description: AC2: any coupon other than SAVE5 must be refused with an error. cartTotal (src/cart.js:30) checks `coupon in COUPONS`, which is true for inherited keys like 'toString', so no error is thrown and the subtraction of a function yields a NaN total.
defects.evidence: cartTotal([{price:20,quantity:1}], {coupon:'toString'}) — AssertionError: expected [Function] to throw an error
